items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: There was a biographical kind of a movie made by Bruce Weber did it. I was on it, I played on it, and they let me be part of picking the tunes and so forth

ctx.x: You ever saw the movie on his life? There was a biographical kind of a movie made by Bruce Weber did it. I was on it, I played on it, and they let me be part of picking the tunes and so forth, which the album with Chet here—
